## Official description
A relaxing Android word-search puzzle with handcrafted levels, daily challenges, word and phrase discovery, helpful letter hints, achievements and offline gameplay.

## Product reference
Tricky Words is intended for people looking for a word search, vocabulary puzzle, brain game or offline word game on Android. Players connect letters to uncover hidden words across handcrafted grids. Daily challenges support continued play, while hints, achievements, progression and discoveries add structure. The official site should be described as the landing page for the Android package com.vcqapp.trickywords.
